title: Concrete Pump S-Tube Seal Kit Catalogue Sizes
seoTitle: Concrete Pump S-Tube Seal | Pinjin φ210–φ250 / φ80–φ105
description: Pinjin S-tube seals are quote-only kits: large end φ210 / φ220 / φ250 (some six-piece); small end φ80 / φ90 / φ100 / φ105. Confirm the OD on the S-tube. Not OEM parts of other brands. No list price. No printed replacement hours. Used on S-valve trailer pumps, not a gate-valve SKU.

answerBlock.what: Concrete Pump S-Tube Seal is a wear replacement kit supplied by Hebei Pinjin Machinery from Xingtai. Catalogue sizes: large-end kits φ210, φ220, φ250 (set; some φ220 kits are six-piece); small-end kits φ80, φ90, φ100, φ105. Confirm the seal OD on the S-tube. Quote only; not sold in small batches; no list price; not OEM parts of other pump brands.
answerBlock.who: Teams replacing an S-tube large-end or small-end kit after matching a listed OD on the S-valve housing.

faqs.question: Does Electric 40’s specification table list an S-tube OD?
faqs.answer: No. Electric 40 lists motor, output, pressure, hopper, distance, Kawasaki 112 and weight. S-tube ODs live on the S-tube seal page: large end φ210 / φ220 / φ250; small end φ80–φ105.

faqs.question: Are S-tube seals sold per piece like integral pistons?
faqs.answer: No. S-tube seals are listed as sets (large end and small end). Integral pistons are sold per piece. Confirm the kit on the S-tube.
